title: Email deliveries
intro: Operational history for accepted, queued, retried, failed, and cancelled email attempts.
filters.title: Refine delivery history
filters.hint: Changes stay local until you run the search.
filters.context.label: Context
filters.status.label: Status
filters.emailType.label: Email type
filters.recipient.label: Recipient
filters.company.label: Company
filters.createdFrom.label: Created from
filters.createdTo.label: Created to
detail.title: Delivery detail
detail.description: Safe operational metadata only. “Sent” means the SMTP provider accepted the message; it does not confirm inbox delivery. Message content, subjects, and recipient addresses remain redacted.
timeline.title: Attempt timeline
timeline.description: Recorded worker outcomes and operator actions.
actions.hint: An operator reason is recorded in the audit trail. This action does not claim inbox delivery.
actions.error: The action could not be completed. The delivery state was not changed here.
actions.retryDisabled: Retry is only available for failed deliveries.
actions.cancelDisabled: Cancel is only available for queued or retry-scheduled deliveries.
empty.title: No deliveries match these filters
empty.description: Adjust the filters or expand the time range to inspect another set of delivery attempts.
error.restricted.title: Delivery history is restricted
error.restricted.description: You do not have permission to inspect email delivery operations.
error.unavailable.title: Delivery history unavailable
error.unavailable.description: The delivery service is temporarily unavailable. No message content is shown.
refusal.title: Access denied
refusal.description: You do not have permission to view email delivery operations.
result.refused: The action was refused. Review current permissions.
result.stale: The state changed. Reconcile before continuing.
result.contract: The response could not be verified. Actions are unavailable.
result.uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Reconcile before continuing.
